description: This PHP file defines the 'Article' controller class within the OpenCart admin namespace, responsible for generating JSON data files related to articles and countries in the catalog. It includes methods for initializing tasks, listing countries, retrieving country info, and clearing generated files.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing article-related JSON file generation and country data handling in the Opencart admin catalog task namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes tasks for clearing and listing articles, setting up store-specific country list tasks, and returning a success message.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file of countries for a given store and language, including task scheduling.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed information about a specific country, including zones and geo zones, and saves it to a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated country JSON files for all stores and languages.
